description: A plain rank-and-file chinese archer in the supplied pixel art style. A round grey padded cap, short dark hair, grey quilted armor with pale trim, cream sleeves, dark bracers, a red neck scarf, a red waist sash with a red front cloth, dark boots with a tan band. A brown leather quiver of white-feathered arrows on a strap across the back. He holds a tall plain wooden bow
face: A young determined face, no beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the round grey cap, short dark hair, the red scarf, grey quilted armor, the brown quiver of arrows on its strap across the back, the red sash, the bow at his left side.
guard_action: the left hand raises the bow in front of the body, the right hand comes to the string, the feet take an archer stance

actions.idle: Archer ready stance, bow held in front in the left hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the bow in the left hand, no shooting. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.pb1: Side-on shot. Frames 1-6 he turns the body fully side-on to the target and draws; frame 9 release; frames 10-11 hold side-on. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.pb2: Two quick shots. Frames 1-5 a fast draw; frame 6 release; frames 7-9 a second fast draw; frame 10 release; frame 11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.pa3: Low shot. Frames 1-6 he bends the knees deeply and draws the bow on a low flat line; frame 9 release; frames 10-11 hold low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.ps2: Focused shot. Frames 1-7 he settles, draws steadily and holds the aim; frame 9 one release; frames 10-12 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 pb1 → pb2 → pa3, 전법 ps2. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정. 기본 병종. 원화는 활을 오른손에 들고 있어 정면·후면을 좌우로 뒤집어 넣었다(본은 왼손). 활이 116px로 본 기준 68px보다 길다. 회색 옷 원화는 사용자가 다시 뽑은 것(2026-11-20, base-sheets-v2/archer.png).
variety_ok: 활 유형은 쏘는 동작끼리 뼈대 거리가 원래 가깝다(공용 궁 유형은 이 검사에서 제외돼 있다). bow_long은 그 유형의 활만 늘린 것.
